data.one_liner: Prompt mobile web users to install the Flutter app as a PWA on demand.
data.what_it_does: The package captures the browser's beforeinstallprompt event and exposes a singleton API to check if the prompt is available and to trigger it. It lets you show the install prompt from a button or any user action.
use_when: You need a custom install button for a Flutter web app running on mobile browsers
You want to control when the PWA install prompt appears rather than relying on the browser's automatic prompt
avoid_when: Your app is not deployed to the web or targets only native platforms
You rely on native app store distribution instead of PWA
strengths: Works across all Chromium‑based mobile browsers that support PWAs
No extra permissions or native code required
weaknesses: Only works on browsers that fire beforeinstallprompt
Requires manual addition of a script to web/index.html
data.setup_notes: Add the provided <script> block to web/index.html, then call PWAInstall().setup() (optionally with an installCallback) before runApp() in main.dart
